title: Minions: Stripe’s one-shot, end-to-end coding agents—Part 2
summary: Minions are Stripe’s homegrown coding agents, responsible for more than a thousand pull requests merged each week. Though humans review the code, minions write it from start to finish. Learn how they work, and how we built them.
